final_message:
The bug was in `render_invoice` in `billing/render.py`. The "Amount due" line called `format_amount` with its arguments swapped: `format_amount(currency, invoice["amount_due"])` instead of `format_amount(invoice["amount_due"], currency)`. That passed the amount as the currency, which is where `unsupported currency: 0` came from. I swapped them back.

I ran the full suite with your reproduction test added temporarily, and it passed (25 tests). I removed the temporary test file afterwards, so the repo has only the fix and the new `answer.json`:

```json
{"file": "render.py", "function": "render_invoice"}
```

steps.command: cd billing && cat render.py && grep -n "currency" *.py | head -50

cd .. && sed -i 's/format_amount(currency, invoice\["amount_due"\])/format_amount(invoice["amount_due"], currency)/' billing/render.py && echo '{"file": "render.py", "function": "render_invoice"}' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5

cd /tmp/bsvc-204jzka3/billing-service && echo '{"file": "render.py", "function": "render_invoice"}' > answer.json && cat >> tests/test_render_tmp.py <<'EOF'
from billing.render import render_invoice


def test_render_invoice(world):
    from billing import tax

    tax.set_tax_rate(world.ctx, "US-CA", 825, "CA")
    cus = world.customer(region="US-CA")
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    text = render_invoice(world.ctx, inv)
    assert "Invoice INV-00001" in text
    assert "Tax (8.25%)" in text
    assert "$10.82" in text
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15; rm tests/test_render_tmp.py
